questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "turnover" mean?
options: The interest rate set by the central bank
The number of new companies listed
The profit earned by a single company
The total amount of money traded in the market
questions.explain_en: Turnover refers to the total value of shares that were bought and sold during the trading day.
questions.explain_zh: 「turnover」指的是當天買賣的股票總金額。

questions.explain_en: The summary states the index closed at 47,940.13 points on September 30.

questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "advanced packaging" mean?
options: A way to sell chips at a higher price
A method of designing chips with more layers to improve performance
A marketing term for new chip brands
A type of software used for AI algorithms
questions.explain_en: Here "advanced packaging" refers to a technology that stacks or connects chips in complex ways to boost speed and efficiency.
questions.explain_zh: 「advanced packaging」指的是將晶片以複雜方式堆疊或連接，以提升速度與效能的技術。

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "tightening" mean?
questions.explain_en: "Tightening" means making the disclosure rules stricter or more rigorous.
questions.explain_zh: 「tightening」在此指的是把資訊揭露的規定變得更嚴格。

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "franchise" mean?
options: A type of loan offered to customers
A brand or business model the bank is expanding

questions.question: According to the summary, who will now pay the portion of estate tax for property gifted within two years of death?
questions.explain_en: The amendment makes the recipients of the gifts bear that portion of the estate tax proportionally.
questions.explain_zh: 修正案規定，受贈人需按比例負擔遺產稅的那一部分。

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "overheating" mean?
options: Too much economic growth that could cause inflation
The central bank's computers getting too hot
A sudden drop in the stock market
A rise in Taiwan's weather temperature
questions.explain_en: Here "overheating" refers to the economy growing too fast, which may create inflation pressure.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「overheating」指的是經濟成長過快，可能導致通膨壓力。

questions.question: For how many consecutive quarters has Taiwan's central bank kept the discount rate unchanged?
questions.explain_en: The summary states it is the tenth consecutive quarter the rate was held at 2%.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明已連續第十個季度維持2%的貼現率。
